editorial: In the artificial intelligence ecosystem, large-scale acquisitions and next-generation flash models are coming to the fore today. In particular, speculations about a potential Nvidia and Hugging Face merger and competency tests of coding agents on software architecture form the main agenda of the day.

items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.summary: Archify is an AI agent skill that generates technical diagrams, such as architectural flowcharts and data loops, as verifiable and interactive HTML files. Used to visualize complex system designs, this tool supports high-resolution exports of the outputs.

items.title: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.summary: Awesome-gpt-image-2 is a library that adopts a 'prompt as code' approach for visual generation models. It aims to improve the quality of outputs obtained from AI with over 530 reverse-engineered examples and more than 20 industrial templates.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: Claude Plugins, published by Anthropic, is a directory containing official plugins developed for the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code. This resource brings together verified plugins that allow developers to add customized capabilities to their projects.

items.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
items.summary: free-claude-code, developed by Alishahryar1, is a tool that provides free access to various AI models via the terminal or an integrated development environment (IDE). It offers users the opportunity to use popular AI models such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode with free token limits.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: ai-job-search, developed by MadsLorentzen, is a Claude Code-based AI-powered job search framework. Allowing users to personalize their resumes, prepare cover letters, and get ready for interviews, this tool performs all operations locally on the computer.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.summary: Claude-obsidian is an AI-powered personal knowledge management tool that runs on the note-taking application Obsidian. It uses the Claude AI model to automatically analyze added content, link it together, and create an organized information network in Markdown format.

items.title: basecamp/omarchy
items.summary: Omarchy, developed by Basecamp, is a visually modern and standards-based configuration tool for Linux operating systems. This shell script-based project allows users to make their operating system installations more organized and consistent.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: Prepared for those who want to start from scratch in the field of AI engineering, this resource offers an end-to-end process from the development of models with the Python programming language to their deployment. By combining theoretical knowledge with practical applications, it enables developers to build their own AI-based products.

items.title: tinyhumansai/openhuman
items.summary: Developed in the Rust language, OpenHuman is an AI-based assistant that creates a user-specific memory by storing personal data in a local environment. The software manages AI agents that perform different tasks, automating complex workflows and supporting in-depth research processes.

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.summary: Ponytail is a JavaScript library that enables AI agents to produce solutions with minimal effort in software development processes. By preventing unnecessary code writing, it aims for systems to operate in the shortest and simplest way possible.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.summary: The Claude plugin directory shared by Anthropic brings together community plugins developed for the AI-powered coding tools Claude Code and Claude Cowork. This platform allows developers to share their own tools and expand the capabilities of AI agents.

items.title: ConardLi/garden-skills
items.summary: Garden-skills is an open-source collection of skills developed for various functions such as web design, information retrieval, and image generation. It aims to accelerate development processes by bringing together modular functions that software developers can integrate into their projects.

items.title: browser-use/browser-use
items.summary: Browser-use is a Python library that enables AI agents to interact with websites just like humans. This tool, which controls the browser to automate web-based processes, allows complex online tasks to be performed by AI.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: Scientific-agent-skills is a library containing 163 verified skills and over 100 scientific databases that specialize AI agents in scientific research processes. It enables agents working in the fields of biology, chemistry, and medicine to perform data analysis in a way that is compatible with platforms such as the code editor Cursor or the AI assistant Claude Code.

items.title: marin-community/marin
items.summary: Marin is an open-source Python framework designed for the research and development of foundation models. It aims to standardize the processes of training and optimizing large-scale AI models.

items.title: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
items.summary: Awesome-agent-skills gathers over 1000 AI agent skills created by developer teams and the community into a single resource. This collection works compatibly with popular tools such as the coding assistant Cursor and command-line interfaces for AI models (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI).

items.title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $13B
items.summary: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, an open-source platform for AI models, for $13 billion. This move strengthens hardware manufacturer Nvidia's presence in the software ecosystem and its access to AI development tools.

items.title: AWS Acquires DuckLabs
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has acquired DuckLabs, a developer of serverless data processing tools. This move aims to strengthen the data analytics and automation capabilities of cloud computing service provider AWS.

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash, developed by Zhipu AI, is a new large language model focused on low latency and high efficiency. The model aims to reduce processing costs, especially in applications requiring fast responses.

items.title: Tim Curry has died
items.summary: British actor Tim Curry, known for his iconic roles in productions such as The Rocky Horror Picture Show and It, has passed away at the age of 80. The artist, who had a large fan base in the world of cinema and theater, brought to life many characters remembered for his versatile acting.

items.title: CEO fired developers to make room for AI. Developers create open source AI CEO
items.summary: After a company laid off its software developers and replaced them with AI, developers created an open-source AI manager (OpenExecutive) that automates corporate management processes. This project aims to digitize management processes by moving corporate decision-making mechanisms to a code-based structure.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and textual data. Published on HuggingFace, the platform where AI models are shared, this model is used in fast text generation and image analysis processes.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash, developed by Zai-org, is an AI model focused on text generation. Optimized for fast inference processes, this model offers an efficient alternative in the large language models category.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen2.5-27B, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text data. Thanks to its open-weights structure, it allows developers to utilize text and image analysis capabilities in their own applications.

items.title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
items.summary: Unsloth is an optimization library that enables faster and more efficient training of large language models. The Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF model is a high-performance artificial intelligence model optimized with this library, operating with low memory usage.

items.title: OBLITERATUS/Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED is an editing project performed on the text-generation model Qwen. This version, which focuses on removing the model's safety filters and restrictions, was developed to provide users with an artificial intelligence experience that has fewer limitations.

items.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
items.summary: SWE Refactor Bench is a new evaluation tool that measures the ability of software agents to perform complex stack migrations across an entire repository. By overcoming the blindness issues caused by existing tests, it mandates that agents not only pass tests but truly transform the codebase.

items.title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans
items.summary: The modular agent developed for spatial relationship verification in computed tomography (CT) scans aims to enhance the visual reasoning capability of medical imaging systems. It aims to resolve the errors that existing vision-language models experience when performing spatial inference, using a verifiable and reliable structure.

items.title: RetrievalRouter: Joint Modality and Architecture Selection for Document Retrieval
items.summary: RetrievalRouter is a system that automatically selects the method and architecture needed for document retrieval processes. In complex documents used in fields such as finance and healthcare, it optimizes the balance between speed and accuracy to determine the most appropriate retrieval pipeline.

items.title: Real-TurnTurk: A Multimodal Turkish Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction
items.summary: Real-TurnTurk is a multimodal dataset developed to model turn-taking dynamics in natural Turkish conversations. Containing unscripted dyadic interactions, this study allows simultaneous dialogue systems to more accurately predict the flow of human speech.

items.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
items.summary: A new study proposes the next-chunk reasoning reinforcement learning method for training models with data that does not contain explicit chain-of-thought labels. This approach allows the model to generate implicit reasoning traces, offering a training strategy alternative to standard supervised fine-tuning methods.

items.title: Changes to SourceHut's terms of service regarding LLMs
items.summary: The software development platform SourceHut has updated its terms of service to prohibit the unauthorized use of content on the platform for training generative AI models. With this change, it aims to create a legal protective shield against the collection of code and data shared by users for commercial purposes by artificial intelligence companies.

items.title: Haiku R1/beta6 released
items.summary: The open-source operating system project Haiku has released version R1/beta6. The update offers improvements to hardware drivers and the user interface while increasing the stability of the system.

items.title: Merchants of Insecurity
items.summary: The concept of 'merchants of insecurity' criticizes how cybersecurity companies position their products using fear-based marketing strategies. Instead of managing real risks, this approach directs security spending in the software industry by creating a constant perception of need based on uncertainty.

glossary.explanation: Specialized capabilities used by AI-powered software to perform a specific task.
Managing prompts given to artificial intelligence by versioning and editing them, similar to software code.
Small extensions used to expand the existing features of a software or add new functionalities to it.
A development environment where programmers can find all the tools they need while writing code in one place.
The smallest unit of data corresponding to words or syllables that artificial intelligence uses when processing texts.
A skeleton that offers a set of ready-made structures and rules to facilitate tasks while developing software.
Storing and managing personal notes, ideas, and information in an organized manner in a digital environment.
A simple text file that runs on the command line, written to automate processes on a computer.
The process of designing and developing systems that solve real-world problems using artificial intelligence models.
Intelligent software that can make decisions on its own, use tools to achieve goals, and interact with its environment.
Specialized skills that enable a software or artificial intelligence to successfully complete a specific task.
Massive artificial intelligence models trained on very large datasets that can serve as a foundation for many different tasks.
Technical competencies that autonomous software needs to perform complex tasks.
A massive cloud platform that provides computing services such as servers, storage, and databases over the internet.
Artificial intelligence models trained on vast amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
An open-source artificial intelligence management system designed to automate corporate management processes.
